subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` suppress explicit Gateway control-plane `update.run` managed handoffs on supervised/headless installs, or remain scoped to configured background auto-update applies?
rationale: The source boundary is clear, but changing the env variable from background auto-update policy to explicit update-run policy can block an operator-requested update and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Honor the env for Gateway `update.run`
options.body: Block supervised managed handoff creation before restart scheduling when the env is set, and update docs/tests to make the headless kill-switch contract explicit.

options.title: Keep the env background-only
options.body: Document that explicit `update.run` requests can still restart supervised Gateways and route no-op/latest launchd reliability to the broader handoff tracker.

options.title: Add a separate explicit policy
options.body: Introduce a new documented setting or env var for control-plane update restarts instead of broadening the existing auto-update kill-switch.

recommendation.title: Honor the env for Gateway `update.run`
recommendation.body: Block supervised managed handoff creation before restart scheduling when the env is set, and update docs/tests to make the headless kill-switch contract explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the kill-switch and is already connected to the broader launchd update-run contract discussion.
